profile.summary: Full stack software engineer focused on applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts to software applications. Also have ample knowledge of data science, algorithm analysis, computer systems, database management, and business administration. Strengths include grit, time management, teamwork, and creativity.

positions.title: Amazon SDE intern
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: My internship project was to automate ticket handling for my team and org. Prior to my project, my team would have to manually debug each ticket by going through many logs and other info. My project enabled info required to debug a ticket to written back to the ticket as a comment whenever a ticket was cut or modified, potentially cutting down on several hours of manual work. My project architecture was a two tier set-up of AWS services SNS, SQS, and Lambda, first in Gamma and then in Prod. Whenever a ticket was cut or modified, the SNS in Gamma would be triggered and would pass the info to SQS and then from SQS to Lambda. The Gamma Lambda would determine which Prod SNS to contact by parsing the ticket info. The handler for the Prod Lambda would publish a comment to the ticket. I also set up the infrastructure code (CDK) for this project and unit tested new code. In addition to working on this project, I also attending team stand-up and sprint meetings and attended workshops regarding topics such as Gen AI.

projects.title: Distributed Bitcoin Miner
projects.description: I worked on this project implemented in Go with a partner. There are two main parts to this project. In the first part, we implemented the Live Sequence Protocol (LSP), a homegrown protocol for providing reliable communication with simple client and server APIs on top of the Internet UDP protocol. Each message sent over an LSP connection has the following six values: message type, connection ID, sequence number, payload size, checksum, and payload. LSP uses a sliding window protocol that represents an upper bound on the range of messages that can be sent without acknowledgment. It also uses epoch events to one, retransmit messages between server and client that may have been dropped, and two, detect when the connections they are communicating with timeout. In the second part of the project, we implemented a simple distributed system for bitcoin mining using our LSP implementation. There are three components to the implementation—clients that initialize mining requests, miners, and a server that manages the entire mining operation. The implementation handles failures ex. if a miner loses contact with the server, and the server uses a scheduler to effectively distribute work among miners based on job size and time of job arrival.

projects.title: Web Proxy
projects.description: I implemented a simple web proxy in C. This proxy accepts incoming connections, reads and parses requests, forwards requests to web servers, reads the servers’ responses, and forwards the responses to the corresponding clients. The proxy can also deal with multiple concurrent connections by using threading.
